resolution.round24_verdict_status: stands: seed33 final greedy is 6/6 on-time on all 16 dev scenes; ROUND24's zero-degradation claim is what the raw rows say
resolution.round29_audit_status: its dev-block task numbers (5/16 failures) were seed-11 rows and are corrected here; the block-ownership core of the ROUND29 correction (1301000..1301015 is the ROUND22/24 development block, 1400031 lives in 1400000..1400063) is unaffected and remains registered
